genuine.narrative: ParseError is caught and triggers fallback, but malformed config from origin is a different failure mode than origin unreachability. If origin returns garbage, the code serves stale config without distinguishing this from a network outage — operators cannot tell if the origin is broken vs. unreachable.

Returns `{"ok": True, "updated": len(LABELS)}` on exception, which is indistinguishable from a successful PUT. The caller has no way to know the sync failed. Either return a distinct failure marker or re-raise/log the exception.
The entire freshness check logic (lines 8-12) needs replacement to actually parse and compare the date string from the file content against the current date, not rely on filesystem metadata.
